verdict.rationale: Polar has a broad public API: versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs, official typed SDKs, a Checkout Session API, webhook endpoint CRUD, per-API-call proration options, and an MCP server that acts across products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI. Several flows (meter management, checkout link configuration, payouts and balance) are described only as dashboard or Finance-page features. The 404s on root-level OpenAPI paths do not contradict the docs-hosted specs. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for meters, checkout links and payouts/finance, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Call the Polar API with full type safety using one of our official SDKs.
If you want to integrate more deeply the checkout process with your website or application, you can use our dedicated API.
You pick the proration behavior either at the organization level (as the default) or per API call.
Agents can look up data and take actions across your products, customers, subscriptions, orders, benefits, and more.
